card: This PR replaces the BCC and eBPF tracing toolchain in USDT functional tests with GDB. Testing tracepoints previously required BCC, matching host kernel headers, and root permissions to load BPF programs, preventing unprivileged local testing and requiring a privileged Docker container in ASan CI. Launching nodes as GDB child processes verifies probe metadata, triggers, and argument values without elevated permissions while removing roughly 660 lines of embedded BPF and CI code. The main trade-off is that external eBPF loading paths are no longer exercised and LeakSanitizer must be disabled on traced children due to ptrace limitations.
changed_since_previous: The underlying approach and commits remain the same; minor updates adjust the CI base image tag and refine GDB USDT probe argument handling.
evidence: PR description: 'All five tests can run with GDB and binutils, without BCC or matching kernel headers. The ASan CI job no longer needs a privileged container and uses SYS_PTRACE instead.'
PR description: 'This also removes the embedded BPF programs from the tests, reducing their size and maintenance burden. Overall, the change removes roughly 660 lines of test and CI code.'
PR description notes the tradeoff: 'LeakSanitizer is disabled for nodes run under GDB because it cannot operate under ptrace. Other sanitizer checks remain enabled.'
problem: USDT functional tests previously required BCC to compile and attach eBPF programs, which required root or BPF privileges and host kernel headers matching the running kernel. This prevented tests from running in standard unprivileged local development environments and forced the ASan CI task to use a privileged container with dynamic host kernel header installation.

risk.why: Changes are confined to test harness execution and CI environment scripts, with no production node code touched.

scope_notes: Touches only functional test files, CI setup scripts, and documentation; introduces a GDB wrapper in test_framework/usdt.py and removes embedded C/BPF code across five USDT tests.
summary: Replaces the BCC and eBPF tracing framework in USDT functional tests with GDB. Tested nodes run as GDB child processes that hook SystemTap tracepoints and record probe arguments when hit. This eliminates dependencies on the BCC toolchain, matching host kernel headers, and elevated BPF/root privileges, allowing USDT tests to run without root permissions and dropping Docker privileged mode in CI.
